title: German Pork Skewers
description: Delicious and savory pork skewers with a German twist. Perfect for a summer barbecue or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to pat dry the pork cubes before marinating.

ingredients.name: Unique German beer mustard
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade, whichever you prefer.

ingredients.name: German-style potato dumpling seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a mixture of salt, pepper, and paprika for a flavorful seasoning.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes before use to prevent them from burning.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the pork and skewers during grilling.

instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (400°F/200°C).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the beer mustard, potato dumpling seasoning, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
3. Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
4. Thread the marinated pork cubes onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
5. Brush the olive oil onto the pork and skewers to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
7. Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
8. Serve the German Pork Skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
